name: Today, I'll Be The Hero
source:
You're the hero, and you're going to save the princess with your merry little crew.

This is what you wanted.

What else is there to say?

[From [url=https://mokadevs.itch.io/today-ill-be-the-hero]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是勇者，正要带着你那支快活的小队前去营救公主。

这正是你梦寐以求的一切。

还有什么好多说的呢？

[摘自[url=https://mokadevs.itch.io/today-ill-be-the-hero]itch.io[/url]]
